description.value: Big Wheel Burger is a Victoria-born fast food chain and Canada's first carbon neutral fast food restaurant, open since 2011 and now operating five locations. The Cook Street Village outpost is surrounded by a community garden the company created from an unused boulevard. It sources 100% fresh BC beef, local buns from Irene's Bakery, and dairy from Island Farms, making it a locally-rooted stop for a calorie-dense meal on a touring ride.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 80m; staple (4 spaces) at 98m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active Cook Street location with recent social media posts from May 2026. Takeout and online ordering are explicitly offered; the menu confirms multiple plant-based, gluten-free, and vegan options with a dedicated GF fryer. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging, or water refill appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: No phone number in OSM or on website.
Website confirms a Cook Street location but does not list a street number, so the OSM address (341 Cook Street) could not be independently verified.
Blog (September 2024) notes the Nanaimo location closed — not relevant here but shows the chain does close locations; Cook Street location shows no closure signals.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast food restaurant with confirmed Cook Street presence and recent May 2026 social media activity; straightforward include.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Two house-made plant-based burgers (Nashville Hawt Chickpea, Yam & Black Bean available vegan); GF buns; dedicated GF fryer; vegetarian and GF poutine gravy

wow_evidence: Canada's first carbon neutral fast food restaurant, open since 2011 and now operating five locations...locally-rooted stop for a calorie-dense meal on a touring ride
